name: permission-slips
description: Scoped, expiring grants for risky agent actions. Only a prompt you type issues one, and a hook outside the model checks it.

interface.shortDescription: Grants only your prompt can issue
interface.longDescription: Scoped, expiring grants for risky agent actions such as deploys, migrations and package publishes. Only a prompt you type issues one, and a hook outside the model checks it before the tool call runs. Supports Codex and Claude Code. See the repository for setup, tested behavior and limitations.
defaultPrompt: Explain which permission slips this session holds and what they allow.

publication.release_notes: First release: slip issuer, guard, example policy and tests.
